idea-plugin.name: AI Multi Profiles
idea-plugin.description:
Separate AI accounts in one chat. Use personal and work profiles in AI Assistant and Air, switch accounts or agents, and continue with the context you choose to share.

  • Separate sign-in for each profile.
  • A Default Profile for each project. Switching a chat's profile leaves that default unchanged.
  • Continue the current chat or start a new chat with another profile.
  • Hide old or unused models and set your own order, with the model you use most first.
  • In Air, see which account the selected profile's agent is using.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 build 262.10968 or newer, with AI Assistant or Air, Node.js, and an installed ACP-compatible agent.

Source and guide: AI Multi Profiles on GitHub.
